blurb: Guests play private escape room games with immersive themes ranging from horror to family-friendly adventures. Locations include Greer, Spartanburg, and Inman, each offering unique rooms and experiences. Birthday parties, team-building events, and fundraisers are also available with dedicated party rooms at select locations.
